verdict.rationale: The pack documents no batch or bulk endpoint, such as bulk ingest, bulk update, or bulk delete across chosen items. What it does show is adjacent behavior: cascading deletes when a user or node is removed, a single-graph clone, and zepctl's vaguely described "data operations". None of these is a user-directed bulk operation across many items, so they earn no credit under the adjacent-feature rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
